plotEn:
Isaac Jefferson, a former R&B artist, performs in a barely occupied bar during the holiday season in New York. Being discouraged from the lack of enthusiasm for his performance, Isaac hurries outside getting struck by a car. During this life changing moment, Isaac decides to bargain with God, his commitment to the church for the Lord sparing his life.
Back in Georgia having left his old dreams behind, Isaac is at his fathers bedside. Gravely ill, he asks Isaac to go back to New York to pastor his great grandfathers neglected and dilapidated church. Knowing he's not nearly as capable or into the church as his older brother, he ruminates on the idea, ultimately deciding to go with his wife, Rebecca, and two sons, Jacob and their nonverbal son, Esau to New York.
The church is maintained by the upbeat Deacon Daniel who welcomes the family to reside in the living quarters above the church. While settling in, Isaac sees that the church is debt for over $50,000. Deacon Daniel admits that he's aware but not much can be done with the church's conditions and the neighborhood thriving in malfeasance.
Adjusting to the new life he's committed to, Isaac runs into an old show promoter, Ethmai Lived who reminds Isaac of his hits and high times as an R&B artist. Expressing interest in Isaac's past and not his presence, he reassures Isaac that he still has fans who'd like to hear his old music and offers him to come perform at his club anytime he wants to step away from the pulpit.
